name: Pay 2 life for a shockland that unlocks a hand card on turn 1-2
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a shockland from hand and pay the 2 life when doing so makes some other hand card payable that is not payable now - Sacred Foundry unlocking Guide of Souls with nothing else up. A free untapped land always wins when one is available (this play's false repeats U's own key), and life stays unspent below 8: at 7 or less the 2 life is not worth a one-drop this early. Also stands down once a fetch in hand could reach the same kind of unlock for a FREE BASIC (F's own true key, narrowed 2026-09-14 to unlocks_by_basic_search rather than the broader unlocks_by_search) - a fetch that can find a free basic untapped land is strictly better than paying 2 life for a tapped-unless-paid shock. Fixes the documented known limit (Sacred Foundry + Arid Mesa + Guide of Souls: Arid Mesa's only library reach there is a second Sacred Foundry, not a basic, so its own unlocks_by_basic_search is false and this play's false condition no longer wrongly matches it - P now fires and pays once, rather than standing down for F to pay the fetch's own life on top of the shock's). A fetch that can only reach a non-basic no longer suppresses P at all; open-fetch-unlocks-shock picks that hand up instead. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
